caption: The drawing depicts a single object: a metallic pitcher or creamer rendered in soft shades of graphite and subtle hints of color such as blue, brown, and silver tones, suggesting reflective surfaces. The vessel has a wide belly, a narrow neoclassical-style stem, and a squared base. Its handle extends upward and outward in a broad arc, attached to the upper part of the body and the rim. The spout is pronounced and curves outward, opposite the handle. The pitcher stands centrally on the page, and there is no other object or background detail, as the paper around the drawing is blank except for a faint rectangular outline that frames the object. The edges of the paper show some discoloration with a light tan border.
title: Silver Pitcher
